properties.name: INFO_MODEL
properties.instruction: Vehicle model name or code. When the user asks what model this car is, answer using INFO_MODEL.

properties.name: WINDOW_POS
properties.instruction: Window position for each area (0 = fully closed, higher values = more open). When the user asks if windows are closed, use WINDOW_POS from the Current State.
